rules.statement: The High Court cannot order a re-trial without specifically setting aside the judgment of the District Court.
rules.supporting_quote: Can the High Court order for re-trial without specifically setting aside the judgment of the District Court? – No.
rules.statute_citation_verbatim: Section 5(C)1) of the High Court of the Provinces (Special Provisions) (Amendment) Act No. 54 of 2006
